column4: 1. Weightages for each System / Subsystem shall be based on the estimated man-hours for the same.
2. Plan dates shall be consistent with the respective activity schedules as per the latest revision of Pre-commissioning and Commissioning Schedules
3. Contractor shall submit applicable system /sub-system details alongwith proposed changes, if any, for Company review / approval.
4.  If any of the Control Points mentioned above are not applicable for any particualr system/ subsystem, Progress will be claimed only after achievement of its subsequent Control Point.
